text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
D-D-Doto-san. Do you have a moment to 
talk!? I know this is incredibly forward 
of me, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding Doto-san's recent condition, 
and the Umamusume's peak blooming 
period..."

—On that day. Agnes Digital plucked up her 
courage and gave advice to Meisho Doto.

What will come of it? The day has finally 
arrived to find the answer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my fav... I can't bear to look 
directly at my fav!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san's... first graded race! Please 
don't let my words lead you astray, and 
come back safe and sound...!

The Gâ ¡ race, the Nikkei Shinshun Hai. 
Meisho Doto made up her mind to make her 
graded race debut.

She was only the 8th favorite, a modest 
showing, but—
(Crash!)
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto! Meisho Doto finishes in an 
unexpected second place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bouncing back from second-to-last at the 
end of the year to run an absolute 
stormer! Just what in the world happened 
here—!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Second place?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my fav, my fav did ittt! Without 
being led astray by my petty 
remonstrances!

Even so, Agnes Digital couldn't shake the 
regret of meddling where she shouldn't 
have. And then—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Digital-saaan! Thank you so very much, 
Digital-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because Digital-san talked to me about 
reaching peak condition, I was able to 
endure even when things weren't going well 
at all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to believe that ‘It's okay, 
it's okay. You'll make it soon.’ I'm just 
so full of gratitude..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
D-Doto-san!? Wait, wait, wait! Any more 
than this and it'll melt... it's gonna 
melt...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Digital-san! 
*sniff* Thank you so, so much~~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *pooouuuf...*

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Peach blossoms drifting on the stream... 
My body is... so... content...

Having received such heartfelt gratitude, 
Agnes Digital remained purified for a 
while...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? I'm so sorry, I lost consciousness 
from the top-tier fan service...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, Doto-san, were you okay with that? 
Me talking like I knew what was best for 
you, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was really grateful for it though~ 
Someone like me can't get stronger unless 
people teach me and we cheer each other 
on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that how it works? I figured 
high-and-mighty folks like Doto-san didn't 
need stuff like that...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-Beings from heaven~? Awawa, I'm nothing 
like that at all~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me can't do anything all 
alone, so I need to learn more, experience 
more... and close that gap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-Surprisingly, it wasn't a bother at all, 
was it...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And... I see, "close the gap," was it? In 
other words, you mean something like this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Are you saying that it's... that hard to 
part with Opera O-san?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You want to catch up to and stand beside 
your beloved Opera O-san no matter what!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ After all, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because I respect Opera O-san. Someday, I 
want to be a confident Umamusume just like 
her—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Meisho Doto states it flatly, without a 
hint of doubt. Seeing that—a light never 
seen before flickered in Agnes Digital's 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer—nay, comrade. There is one 
question I must ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What does "precious" really mean?!
choice_data_list: That's too big a question to ask...
That's too big a question to ask...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right, I'm sorry... I just... 
don't know what to do anymore...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Keeping a polite distance from the sacred 
Umamusume is basic courtesy. Yet, getting 
involved has birthed—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san's... smile back then... And that 
pure passion as she chases her 
aspirations...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Spilling over in that moment, was a 
radiance... like none I had ever seen 
before...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What... was that just now? It felt a 
little different from the usual 
preciousness...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Without a single trace of the girly fun I 
had imagined, it was pure, 100% blinding 
light...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just what is that mysterious brilliance 
that looks capable of purifying the three 
thousand worlds...?

Agnes Digital pondered deeply for a while, 
and then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaah, I just don't get it at all! It 
makes zero sense! Ugh, my brain is 
overheating!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There are still charms to Umamusume-chans 
that I know nothing about... But moving 
forward, what should I do and how~...
choice_data_list: Want to put it to the test in a race?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A race... That's true. Unless I 
synchronize with my dear Umamusume and run 
together with her, maybe I won't be able 
to see anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Understood. At the Hyacinth Stakes, I 
shall reexamine it. The pure innocence of 
the horse girls!
